Priya (platform PM): Quick async check — where are we on the Dedicated GPU reservations for Q3? Need an updated timeline for the customer-facing runbook.
Morgan (eng-infra): Procurement signed the initial SOW last week, hardware ETA from vendor is still 'late July' per Tom. Rack-space confirmed for Aug 1.
Tom (procurement): Confirming — PO created (PO-87219). Vendor ack'd the build on 2025-07-02. Shipping window 7/20-7/28 tentative. Waiting on final invoice from vendor to trigger payment.
Kelly (finance): I have PO-87219 in the queue, but we need the vendor invoice + updated ship ETA to release the wire. Can @Tom attach the invoice here when it arrives?
Tom (procurement): Will do. I also put the expedited shipping option on hold until we confirm capacity plans from infra.
Morgan (eng-infra): Heads-up: before we can accept racks we need network cross-connects and PDU power strips staged. @Luca can you confirm SRE capacity for racking and initial OS onboarding?
Luca (SRE): We have two SRE on-call slots for the week of Aug 4 already blocked for racking + burn-in. Need ticket with serials and racking diagram. Also need NOC to schedule the cross-connect cutover window (we prefer 02:00-04:00 UTC).
Priya (platform PM): Action items I'm tracking: 1) Tom attach invoice & final ETA (owner: Tom) 2) Morgan provide racking diagram + serial list (owner: Morgan) 3) Kelly release payment once invoice/ETA confirmed (owner: Kelly) 4) Luca schedule burn-in & NOC window (owner: Luca). If anyone wants to reassign ping me.
Tom (procurement): Invoice uploaded: https://payments.redwood/po/PO-87219/invoice-452.pdf — vendor updated ETA 7/25. I set expedited shipping as fallback for 7/22 if we need earlier.
Kelly (finance): Got it. Releasing payment now, will update the payment ref in the PO.
Morgan (eng-infra): Racking diagram and serials attached in the infra runbook: https://redwood-internal/infra/runbooks/dedicated-q3. Short checklist pasted below:
```
- Verify rack U positions 12-18
- Install PDUs (2x per rack)
- Connect 10gbe management network
- Label serials and update CMDB
- Run burn-in: 24h stress + thermal sweep
```
Priya (platform PM): Great, thanks. One dependency note: Platform needs NVMe mount permissions set in the provisioning template (we hit a quota yesterday). Morgan, can you file infra-config PR to add new device class?
Morgan (eng-infra): Will open PR today and tag @Priya for review. Expected merge by EOD tomorrow.
Luca (SRE): NOC window request sent. Tentative burn-in schedule Aug 5-6. Will post runbook checklist (scripts + metrics) in the ticket.
infra-bot: Reminder: dedicated-capacity channel kickoff meeting tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Agenda: timelines, fallback plans, runbook ownership.
Priya (platform PM): Optional: if hardware slips beyond 7/28 we should plan for a temporary increase on Hosted API quota to absorb customer traffic. Can product ops draft the contingency?
Morgan (eng-infra): Noted. I'll also prepare a compatibility test matrix vs current model variants so we can validate perf during burn-in.
Tom (procurement): Will confirm expedited option cutoff by 7/18 and share cost diff.
Kelly (finance): If expedited is needed, allocate to project code RF-Dedicated-Q3. Approvers: Kelly + Priya.
Priya (platform PM): Thanks all — I'll consolidate these action items into the project tracker and spin up a short timeline doc. If you update anything here, drop a line so I can keep the customer-facing runbook accurate. :thumbsup:
